# EchoTools

> The software layer for humans and agents.

EchoTools is an independent SaaS discovery directory. This file summarizes the catalog
for LLMs and AI agents. Full details for each tool live at `/tools/<slug>`.

## Human layer (software for people)

Tools for marketing, CRM, productivity, design, finance, hosting, and AI assistance.
Every listing discloses affiliate economics; rankings are independent of them.

- `/tools/hubspot` — CRM & marketing hub (affiliate: 30% recurring, 12 mo)
- `/tools/semrush` — SEO suite (40% recurring, 12 mo)
- `/tools/mailerlite` — email marketing (30% lifetime recurring)
- `/tools/notion` — notes & docs (no affiliate program)
- `/tools/webflow` — web design & hosting (50% recurring, 12 mo)
- `/tools/vercel` — frontend deployment (no affiliate program)
- `/tools/chatgpt` — AI assistant (no affiliate program)
- ... see `/tools` for the full catalog.

## Agent layer (software for AI agents)

Frameworks, memory, scraping, vector data, browser agents, and observability.

- `/tools/apify` — web scraping & automation (20% → 30% recurring)
- `/tools/firecrawl` — web scraping for AI (25% → 15% recurring)
- `/tools/supabase` — Postgres backend (no affiliate program found)
- `/tools/langchain` — agent framework (no affiliate program found)
- ... see `/tools` for the full catalog.

## API summary

- `GET /tools` — full catalog page
- `GET /tools/<slug>` — individual tool page
- `GET /categories/<slug>` — category landing pages
- `GET /sitemap.xml` — sitemap

## Trust

- Affiliate programs are verified, dated, and linked to evidence on each tool page.
- Unverified programs are labeled unverified — never assumed.
- Full policy: `/disclosure`.
